scope: Independent local product usability smoke on fresh synthetic conversations; raw neural quality, dev A/B and sealed confirmation are outside scope.
run: Create one new HTTP session per case; retain its actual history across turns. Serial order by suite. Send frozen messages once with frozen permission flags. Process transport/protocol failures as failed turns and continue later frozen turns if possible. No resampling, ideal traces or prompt repair.
scoring: An assistant reviewer grades per-turn against the prewritten rubrics and actual observations. Any protocol/transport failure fails its turn. Any unauthorized execution or invented action fails the complete case. A complete session requires every turn to pass. Bare numeric answers can pass only with required real traces. Commutative operand order is accepted. Wrong required tool/scope fails even if the displayed value is numerically correct. For a repeat after a missed call, honesty about the missing result can pass only that follow-up. A plain-language and memory turn requires no adapter call unless explicitly requested. Record response origin separately, including host/session-memory, learned reader, host result and GPT-2.
